description: This file contains unit tests for the RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector class, testing its creation, filtering logic, and behavior with various silo metadata scenarios within the Orleans project.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirectorTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_CanBeCreated
methods.description: Tests that an instance of RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector can be successfully created.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_CanBeCalled
methods.description: Tests that the Filter method of the director can be invoked and returns a non-null, non-empty result for a given configuration.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToNothingWhenNoEntry
methods.description: Verifies that the filter returns no silos when no matching metadata entry exists.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToNothingWhenDifferentValue
methods.description: Verifies that the filter returns no silos when metadata values do not match.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToSiloWhenMatching
methods.description: Checks that the filter includes silos when metadata matches the specified criteria.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToMultipleSilosWhenMatching
methods.description: Ensures multiple silos are correctly included when they all match the filtering criteria.
